title: Crowd-carry persistence: positioning extremes that KEEP the prevailing state until an official positioning-flow trigger breaks them

blindness_declaration.law: This document is authored before anyone measures anything for this lane. It declares a mechanism, a rule FAMILY and a representation identity. It contains no outcome numbers, no returns conditional on states, no expectancies, and no signal arithmetic on positioning or prices beyond the structural facts committed in the P0/P1/P2 artifacts. All rule parameters are SYMBOLIC and freeze at D2/S selection, never after any scored number.

mechanism.narrative: Forced unwinds are rare events; crowded extremes are not immediately fragile. Between the formation of a positioning extreme and its eventual unwind, the official geometry can persist at the extreme for many weeks while the underlying move CONTINUES - a crowd-carry regime. In it the FORCED participant is the commercial hedger: as the prevailing move extends, his hedge grows as a mechanical function of physical inventory and forward-book exposure he cannot refuse and cannot re-time, so the official extreme deepens mechanically rather than mean-reverting; on the other side, trend-following speculators are mandated by their own process to stay with the trend until their stops bind, so the speculative side persists by rule, not by courage. The LATE participant is ETP-linked and retail flow, which funds the tail of the carry and arrives last. The mechanism's TIMING CLAIM is that a positioning extreme marks a state that keeps trending UNTIL the forced side's flow visibly breaks in the official series - i.e. until a weekly positioning flow OPPOSING the crowd beyond a declared threshold, or exit of the geometry from the extreme bucket, signals that the carry's fuel (forced hedger absorption met by mandated speculator persistence) is exhausted. Only then does the state terminate and, under the same frozen convention, flip. The declared family therefore HOLDS the prevailing crowd-carry direction while the official geometry stays inside the extreme bucket and no opposing positioning-flow trigger has fired; it is a continuation-until-positioning-trigger family whose every state and trigger is a function of committed report counts only - never of price patterns. A price-only persistence clock is its designated shadow: if 'keep trending until a trigger' works identically with the trigger and state read off price alone, the official flow adds nothing and the proposal dies.

forced_participant.who: the commercial hedger, whose hedge layoff scales mechanically with physical inventory/forward-book exposure as the move extends (inventory constraint binding), alongside the trend-following speculator who persists by mandate until his own stops bind
forced_participant.why_forced: hedging follows the physical book, not a view: the hedger cannot refuse or re-time it, so the official extreme deepens while the move runs; the speculator's persistence is procedural (mandates, stops) and ends mechanically, which is exactly what the positioning-flow trigger observes
forced_participant.late_participant: ETP creation/retail flow funding the carry tail; it arrives last and exits when the forced flow has already turned

mechanism.information_source: official CFTC legacy futures-only reports only (committed P0 structural fields and consecutive-report differences thereof); no prices in any state or trigger
mechanism.state_definition_symbolic: state(t): while g(r_t) is inside a symmetric extreme tail (bucket cuts q_lo, q_hi over rolling window w; g as declared for lane A4) AND no trigger has fired since entry, the state holds direction d = the crowd-carry side (frozen symmetric sign convention); TRIGGER tau(t): a weekly positioning flow f(r_t) = first difference of the committed net geometry opposing the held side beyond symbolic threshold tau, OR exit of g(r_t) from the extreme bucket; on trigger, the state terminates (and may flip under the same frozen convention); parameters w, q_lo, q_hi, tau, holding bound h_max are SYMBOLIC, frozen at D2/S, never after
mechanism.q16_instrument_note: continuation holding makes the drag bill the mechanism's central cost: the family pays the ETP's expense/roll drag for as long as the carry persists (Q-16); the drag is carried in the P1 tier-2.0 ladder and declared in representation_identity.q16_instrument_declaration, and h_max is symbolic precisely so the drag bill is fixed before any scored number

decision_rule_family: continuation-until-positioning-trigger family on the ETP leg: while the official geometry sits in a symmetric extreme tail and no opposing positioning-flow trigger has fired, hold the crowd-carry direction for decision-session closes up to a symbolic bound h_max; on trigger, terminate (flip under the same frozen convention); window w, tail cuts q_lo/q_hi, trigger threshold tau and bound h_max are SYMBOLIC parameters, frozen at D2/S selection and never tuned after any scored number; symmetric in the two tails

representation_identity.law: P-12: code AND representation are committed before any number is cited; this declaration names the exact representation and cites every committed artifact by sha256; nothing here is measured and no signal is computed at D1

q16_instrument_declaration.content: this family HOLDS positions across a symbolic number of weekly closes (up to h_max), so the Q-16 drag is a first-order term: transaction component 2 fills x half-spread CS p90 at tier 2.0 (once per fill), instrument expense accrued linearly over the holding horizon where MEASURED_OFFICIAL_PAGE (official page sha-pinned per leg in p2_gate.json item3), same-underlying tracking divergence per leg from p1_cost_contract.json tracking_proxy as the declared instrument fact; basket leg DBA carries the dispatch-declared basket basis (purity 'basket' per pair in p2_gate.json per_pair_census); h_max is declared SYMBOLIC precisely so the worst-case drag bill is fixed at selection, before any scored number - drag is never assumed away and never tuned after measurement

ancestry_risk_statement.declaration: This proposal names the pooled kill-candidate shadows it must be novel against (plan section 1; D2 pooled |rho| screen) and states, per shadow, why official positioning information differs. This is the claim D2 will test; if any claim is false, the proposal dies at D2 by the pooled screen or by its own battery.

named_kill_candidates.why_different: a continuation family is the family MOST at risk of reducing to momentum, and the risk is declared, not hidden: momentum_63s holds a trailing-price direction with a fixed clock; this family's HOLD state exists only while the OFFICIAL geometry sits in an extreme bucket and its EXIT is a positioning-flow event (a committed report count crossing a threshold) that has no price-derived equivalent - weeks where the crowd is extreme and price flat, or price trending while the crowd is mid-distribution, separate the two. Honest admission: if the entry bucket and the exit trigger are spanned (state rho beyond the frozen ceiling) by a trailing-price form, the momentum_63s veto plus the price-only persistence shadow kill it
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: momentum_63s (generic price momentum; pooled D2 veto set)

named_kill_candidates.why_different: the weekly release clock only timestamps when the state can update; the state itself (extreme-bucket membership and flow trigger) varies across weeks and is frequently INERT (no held position outside extreme buckets with no trigger), while a bare weekday clock holds every week with a fixed side. The release-clock shadow is the designated executioner: if a fixed-direction weekly clock matches the anchor, the geometry adds nothing over the calendar and the proposal dies
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: generic_dow_tue (calendar-clock forms; the CoT release weekday geometry)

named_kill_candidates.why_different: this family is continuation-shaped, the OPPOSITE polarity of a displacement-fade; its exit (and optional flip) is triggered by official flow, not by a price displacement measured over days. The residual risk is that its exits coincide with short-horizon reversal turns (the forced flow breaks when price already broke) - that is an honest overlap claim D2 must test with the v16 veto in the pooled screen; the price-only shadow here carries a price-only trigger so a pure price-timed exit is reproducible without the official flow and the anchor must beat it
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: v16_close_displace_fade (short-horizon price reversal; pooled D2 veto set)

arms.name: crowd-carry persistence arm
arms.spec: the declared rule family: hold the crowd-carry direction while the official geometry sits in a symmetric extreme tail and no opposing positioning-flow trigger has fired (up to symbolic bound h_max); terminate/flip on trigger; symbolic parameters w, q_lo, q_hi, tau, h_max
arms.kill_semantics: anchor; killed by any designated KILLER control out-earning it (see falsification_rule)

arms.name: price-only persistence shadow (MANDATORY, plan section 1)
arms.spec: the SAME tradeable rule (same clock, same hold-until-trigger shape, same symbolic parameters) with BOTH the state and the trigger replaced by price-only analogues: persistence state = trailing ETP price direction beyond a displacement percentile tail; trigger = opposing price event of the same family, all read under the same V7 close+1 convention; NO CoT input whatsoever
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => 'persist until a trigger' is fully reproduced by price alone (momentum_63s class) and the proposal dies

arms.name: bare release-clock shadow
arms.spec: identical holding shape and execution, FIXED direction sign, no state and no trigger: every grid instant pooled (the bare Friday-release weekly clock)
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => the geometry adds nothing over the generic release weekday clock (generic_dow_tue class) and the proposal dies

arms.name: stale-release placebo
arms.spec: the identical state-and-trigger machinery fed reports k release-instants OLDER than the PIT-visible one (k symbolic, >= 4 releases, frozen at selection): preserves weekly clock and marginal geometry while destroying release-aligned information; Q-11: too-few-eligible-instant outcomes are invalid/NOT_RUN, never zero
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => the effect is release-information-independent and the proposal dies

arms.spec: the identical anchor rule at D0 = the P2 later-bound decision session and D1 = the next session after D0; both reported side by side
arms.kill_semantics: diagnostic for clock-placement artifacts; informs the D2 report, does not kill alone

falsification_rule.statement: KILL if, at D2/I on the identical bookable grid, restricted leg set and window under the identical frozen cost treatment, ANY designated KILLER control (the price-only persistence shadow, the bare release-clock shadow, or the stale-release placebo) earns a strictly greater after-cost per-decision edge than the ANCHOR arm. The price-only shadow matching the anchor means 'persist until a trigger' is price momentum in disguise (momentum_63s class); the release-clock shadow matching the anchor means the geometry adds nothing over the release weekday; the stale-release placebo matching the anchor means the release-aligned official flow carries nothing. Declared now, outcome-blind; measurable later from the committed arms alone.
